title: Red Lotus in Ceramic Bowl
description: A vibrant red lotus flower with layered petals and a bright yellow center blooms from a turquoise ceramic bowl filled with smooth pebbles. The bowl floats on dark reflective water surrounded by lily pads under a moody twilight sky with golden reflections.
prompt: A large, detailed red lotus flower with many layered petals and a textured yellow center growing from a weathered turquoise ceramic bowl decorated with blue floral patterns and filled with smooth grey pebbles. The bowl rests on the surface of dark reflective water at twilight, with lily pads floating nearby and warm golden light reflecting on the rippling water, atmospheric and serene digital painting style
